headline: Francis Marion and Lees-McRae meet the sides that beat them
dek: Lees-McRae have lost three matches all season, the first of them at home to North Georgia in August. Francis Marion's first defeat came against Lenoir-Rhyne. On Friday both meet those opponents again, the only programmes in the conference with a match still to play.
displaced_by: The calendar is no longer over: Francis Marion and Lees-McRae each have a match on 2026-11-13, both against sides that beat them earlier in the season.
